propositions: _fold_heads currently merges bundle heads into the worktree HEAD using git merge, causing heal results to depend on the tracker's checked-out branch and making the doctor refuse to heal when current_branch != ref.
The doctor should fold bundle heads into refs/heads/<ref>'s tip using git merge-tree and git commit-tree instead, making healing work regardless of which branch is checked out.

The refusal guard _require_tracker_on_ref should be replaced with a narrower guard that only refuses when ref is checked out AND the worktree is dirty, allowing side-branch and detached-HEAD trackers to heal successfully.

_publish_and_prune must bundle refs/heads/<ref> explicitly and publish the folded result via git update-ref (off-branch) or git reset --hard (on-branch) instead of relying on HEAD to match the merged tip.
A regression test proving the fold resolves .bridge_state/* collisions via merge=ours policy must be added, as no such coverage currently exists in the test suite.
After an off-branch heal, the checked-out branch and worktree must remain unchanged; after an on-branch heal, git status must be empty.
